name: capturemann
description: Screenshots, screen and audio recording, local transcripts, speaker labels and meeting notes, export and publishing, through the CaptureMann app installed on this computer.

capturemann_path.title: CaptureMann command
capturemann_path.description: Path to the capturemann program that CaptureMann installs. Leave the default when capturemann is on your PATH (Linux packages, the Windows installer's PATH option, or a Homebrew or manual link on macOS). On macOS without the link use /Applications/CaptureMann.app/Contents/MacOS/capturemann.
